mapper.select:
SELECT n.*, u.nickname as publisherName FROM sys_notice n LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON n.publisher_id = u.user_id WHERE n.is_deleted = 0
AND n.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{title}, '%')
ORDER BY n.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_notice (title, content, publisher_id, target_type, create_time, is_deleted) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{publisherId}, 0, NOW(), 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_notice SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId}
